cards.title: PIXEL PUSHER
cards.concept: freelance street UI designer in a worn grey hoodie with a cheap earpiece, holding a battered scuffed tablet at her chest, long straight dark hair tucked behind one ear
cards.hook: product designer: 'pixel pusher' is the designer's own nickname for the craft she has made her career

cards.title: ARCADE REPAIR TECH
cards.concept: arcade repair tech in a grey utility jacket with a screwdriver in the breast pocket, holding an opened arcade joystick-and-buttons control panel at her chest
cards.hook: Entertainment Technology at Carnegie Mellon: the games-and-play side of her training

cards.title: VIRTUAL MACHINIST
cards.concept: machinist in grey work coveralls with a small wrench in one hand and a slim grey server blade tucked under the other arm, one tiny cyan LED on the blade
cards.hook: product designer for VMware, the company that made the virtual machine an everyday tool

cards.title: NEON SIGN BENDER
cards.concept: sign-shop apprentice in a grey canvas apron and heat gloves, holding an unlit bent glass tube shaped like a simple heart at her chest
cards.hook: Head of Design: every neon city needs someone who designs its signs by hand

cards.title: STREET INTERPRETER
cards.concept: street interpreter in a grey rain poncho with a cheap translation earpiece, holding up a small boxy handheld translator at her chest
cards.hook: designing for the United Nations, where one interface has to speak to many languages

cards.title: WIREFRAME RUNNER
cards.concept: netrunner in grey techwear with green terminal-code trim, a compact cyberdeck at her chest wired by a thin cable to a small jack on her temple
cards.hook: product design: every screen she ships starts life as a wireframe

cards.title: DRONE CHOREOGRAPHER
cards.concept: drone operator in a green-trimmed utility jacket with a gesture-control ring on one raised hand, a small quadcopter drone with cyan lights hovering beside her head
cards.hook: Entertainment Technology at Carnegie Mellon: staging wonder for an audience, here with drones

cards.title: UPLINK DIPLOMAT
cards.concept: field comms operator in a green-trimmed jacket with a compact satellite-dish antenna rising behind one shoulder and a rugged hand terminal at her chest
cards.hook: designing for the United Nations: keeping many nations connected on one channel

cards.title: COMPONENT TECHIE
cards.concept: techie in a green-trimmed work vest with a tool belt of modular parts, snapping two small green-edged interface blocks together at her chest
cards.hook: product designer for startups: reusable design-system components are how a small team ships fast

cards.title: STYLUS SAMURAI
cards.concept: street samurai in a sleek armoured jacket with glowing teal seams, holding a long glowing teal holo-blade shaped like a designer's stylus upright beside her face
cards.hook: Head of Design: the designer's stylus, sharpened into a blade

cards.title: GPU UX ARCHITECT
cards.concept: interface architect in a long dark coat with glowing cyan seams, one hand in a chrome GPU gauntlet projecting a small teal holographic dashboard card beside her shoulder
cards.hook: Head of Design at Compute Labs, making tokenised GPU compute readable at a glance

cards.title: XR WORLD BUILDER
cards.concept: immersive-experience builder in a teal-seamed high-collared coat with a VR headset pushed up on her forehead, one haptic-gloved hand raising a small glowing teal wireframe cube
cards.hook: Entertainment Technology at CMU and Digital Media at Pitzer: building worlds you can step inside

cards.title: HOLOGRID CONDUCTOR
cards.concept: chrome-augmented conductor in ornate chrome shoulder plates and a high collar, both chrome-gauntleted hands raised to direct a ring of floating violet holographic interface panels behind her
cards.hook: from VMware to the United Nations to startups: orchestrating interfaces at every scale

cards.title: AI WHISPERER
cards.concept: AI whisperer in chrome shoulder plates with violet neon trim, a small glowing violet AI core orb cupped in her palms at her chest, magenta neon sigils floating behind her
cards.hook: her gentle, graceful calm: user-centred design teaches machines to understand people

cards.title: GENESIS DESIGNER
cards.concept: ascended designer in gold and white chrome regalia with a high collar, holding a radiant golden GPU core at her chest, a crown-halo of concentric glowing gold circuit rings studded with GPU cores behind her head and a golden data aura
cards.hook: Head of Design at her ultimate: the calm hand that gives the whole compute world its form
